plan.advantage: Complete-episode Monte Carlo return minus learned state baseline

mass_properties.model: two uniform half-boxes along body x

plan.reward_definition: (distance_before-distance_after)/.15 + success - push_penalty - time cost; invalid -.2; workspace exit additional -1
plan.legacy_return_definition: Progress + success - .02 per valid push; invalid -.2; workspace exit additional -1
plan.additional_reward: Subtract total_time_cost times all simulated macro-action seconds OR free_time_cost times free-space seconds; all settling included
plan.bc_schedule: Weight decays linearly to zero over the requested action budget
plan.best_selection: Maximum monitoring success, then mean reward; earliest tie
plan.curriculum_rule: Full distant training goals from the start; evaluation always uses full distant goals
